queries.name: service_issues_administer_map
queries.sql: SELECT service_issue_id, administer_id FROM service_issues_administer_map WHERE service_issue_id = ? ORDER BY service_issue_id, administer_id

queries.name: service_issues
queries.sql: SELECT id, issueable_type, issueable_id, service_issue_category_id, closed_by_administer_id, last_message_id, closed_at FROM service_issues WHERE id = ? ORDER BY id

queries.name: chat_room_messages
queries.sql: SELECT id, room_code, room_type, chattable_id, chattable_type, body FROM chat_room_messages WHERE room_code = ? ORDER BY id

queries.name: activity_log
queries.sql: SELECT log_name, description, subject_type, subject_id, event FROM activity_log WHERE NOT (subject_type <=> ? AND COALESCE(description, '') LIKE ?) ORDER BY id
